mechanism: Make the existing frozen NumericContext residual optional; learn per-lead convex shrinkage on the old training selection, retain only leads with positive MAE and MSE benefit in every chronological training evidence block. Never force a learned residual when its evidence fails.
partitions: Old memory+early fit unchanged. Old selection fits two numerical shrink coefficients. Old fresh calibration is purged into three equal distinct-clock chronological parts: numerical gate evidence, Wiki epoch selection, fresh Wiki execution certificate. No part contains turbine6 or outer targets. Do not change these parts after viewing results.
ablation: Same newly certified numerical fallback, parameters, initialization, support masks, training labels, selection and calibration budgets; zero only typed case-memory tokens. Not a pure removal of all knowledge.
selection: Same MAE/RMSE jointly non-worse epoch selection including epoch0, on only middle third of original fresh training calibration.
identity: Bind numerical policy to actual original/numeric checkpoint SHA256 and source train packs; bind each Wiki certificate to the actual common numerical gate ID, its own checkpoint and unchanged quality bank.
primary_success: WikiSelective MAE and RMSE both lower than the common CertifiedNumeric and ZeroMemoryIncrementSelective, and also lower than OriginalTrend/Persistence to support a useful end-to-end improvement. Numerical fallback benefits are not Wiki contributions.
budget: One fold1 seed2024 development experiment, two 20-epoch incremental fits; old checkpoints and saved predictions are reused, no old model retraining, no automatic expansion.
limitations: Outer validation has been repeatedly inspected historically: development evidence only. Empirical time-block checks are not a transfer guarantee. Smaller and newly allocated epoch-selection/certificate periods differ from v6, so v6-v7 is a system comparison, not an isolated causal attribution to Wiki.
